verdict.rationale: Increase documents the pieces of programmatic account provisioning. Customers are represented as Entities with API-exposed validations, Ramp spins up accounts per user programmatically, account numbers are created via API, and every API feature is available in Sandbox with simulation APIs. Insurance is evidenced through partner banks and IntraFi FDIC sweeps. However, no evidence documents an account-creation endpoint or an application-to-active lifecycle. Missing for 10: an explicit create-account API and application-to-active onboarding flow, direct FDIC insurance of the base deposit account (only an IntraFi sweep is evidenced), and independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end provisioning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a real, insured deposit account through the API — application to active account fully programmatic, with sandbox parity so the flow is tested before launch

citations.quote: Ramp spins up unique accounts per user, allowing the team to programmatically track payments
Increase makes Entity validations available via the API for each version of the data.
Every API and dashboard feature is available in Sandbox.
Access multi-million-dollar FDIC insurance at participating IntraFi network banks directly in Increase.
Increase provides the API layer on top of a real bank.
